proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Work locally on the base scheme so it is affine and the test cycle is a prime cycle by bilinearity, expand the cap product of the two-step composition with the prime cycle by unfolding the definition at the generic points and taking closures twice, expand the composition-then-cap side by first computing the composed family at the generic point as the cap of the pullback with the generic part of the second family and then capping with the prime cycle, and observe both expansions produce the same integral closed subschemes because a closed integral subscheme is determined by its generic fibre over the base point (source lines 2934-2977)
